evaluation_axis: AX-001 v2 EXEMPT_FROM_AXIOM (pure overlay, NOT defense factor) + Codex_J6_PARTIAL_REBUTTAL crisis-state realized return decomposition supplement
exemption_rationale: AX-001 v2 axiom_text (qepm/memory/axioms/active/AX-001.json): '방어형 팩터는 조건부 성과로 평가 (crisis_alpha + Core 대비 MDD 완화 + bad/normal IC ratio).' Absorption Ratio is NOT a defense-style alpha factor. It is a statistical systemic-risk indicator (Kritzman-Page-Turkington 2011 FAJ §3) used as scalar gross-exposure modulator. No factor signal, no factor exposure, no IC. The conditional-performance evaluation framework (crisis_alpha + bad/normal IC ratio) does not directly apply to a scalar β overlay.

codex_j6_partial_rebuttal.rebuttal_portion: AR overlay is not a defense factor — AX-001 v2 axiom semantically does not apply. REBUTTAL of full AX-001 v2 application.
codex_j6_partial_rebuttal.accept_portion: Codex's underlying methodological concern (verdict's central claim is tail/MDD relief therefore crisis-state conditional decomposition should be reported) is valid. ACCEPT supplemental crisis decomposition.
codex_j6_partial_rebuttal.supplemental_action: Crisis-state realized cumulative returns computed for S0/S1/S2/S3 across 4 stress windows (GFC / Vol_2018Q4 / COVID / Stagflation_2022) using posthoc β · r identity. Full results below.

crisis_state_realized_returns_decomposit.method: cum_ret(β_lag · r_PG2) per crisis window; β_lag = β_{t-1} (PIT); cum returns multiplicative compound

data_source.beta_lag_construction: shift(β, 1, fill=1.0) — same 1-period lag as posthoc_overlay_apply.R lines 38-40

GFC_2008_09_to_2009_03.verdict: AR_OVERLAY_TAIL_DEFENSE_VALIDATED — All 3 variants deliver substantial GFC defense; S1_threshold cuts cum loss from -36.96% to -14.83% (+22.13pp alpha) without modifying alpha composition. AR signal correctly de-risked during GFC systemic concentration (avg_β_threshold=0.486 ⇒ ~half cash exposure).

Vol_2018Q4.verdict: AR_OVERLAY_VOL_2018Q4_BORDERLINE — S1 threshold β=1.0 (no de-risk) suggests AR_t did not exceed q90 trigger during this idiosyncratic KR drawdown. S2/S3 (continuous mappings) provide marginal defense. As predicted in challenge_note risk Section, single-cell idiosyncratic episode is a structural limitation of systemic-risk indicator.

COVID_2020_02_to_2020_04.verdict: AR_OVERLAY_COVID_DEFENSE_VALIDATED — S1 threshold β_avg 0.9 (mild de-risk) +4.25pp; S2/S3 continuous mappings achieve +19.4/+17.0pp. Continuous mappings react faster to COVID-onset systemic concentration spike than discrete threshold.

Stagflation_2022_01_to_2022_10.verdict: AR_OVERLAY_STAGFLATION_DEFENSE_VALIDATED — S1 +2.42pp marginal; S2/S3 +9.6/+8.0pp. AR signal correctly elevated during 2022 inflation-rate spike + KR dollar weakening.

crisis_alpha_summary.metric: tail_defense_alpha = sum across 4 crises of (overlay_cum_ret - S0_cum_ret) in pp
crisis_alpha_summary.interpretation: S1 threshold provides robust GFC defense (+22pp) + COVID defense (+4pp) + Stagflation defense (+2pp) with no Vol_2018Q4 trigger. S2/S3 continuous mappings provide stronger crisis defense at cost of normal-regime SR (degraded -0.19/-0.17). S1 threshold is the optimal trade-off (Sharpe IMPROVED + GFC defense substantial).
